en_title: GTA 6 Leak Seemingly Reveals Full Track List Days Before Launch
cn_title: 《GTA6》泄露内容似乎在发售前数日揭晓完整曲目列表
opus_summary: 《GTA6》发售前数日，官方原声专辑的完整曲目列表似乎在网上泄露，一段社交媒体视频展示了双LP黑胶唱片包装。Rolling Stone称已向消息人士确认曲目列表。该专辑售价50美元(约合人民币334元)，计划于2026年11月19日发售。

paragraphs.en: The full track list for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album seems to have leaked online just days before GTA 6 's launch.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA6》发售前仅剩几天之际，《侠盗猎车手VI：The Album》的完整曲目列表似乎已在网上泄露。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games just can't catch a break. After weeks of unprecedented leaks were published online, even more information about GTA 6 has found its way onto the internet, this time revealing the entire list of every song and artist featured on the official soundtrack's album release.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar似乎总是麻烦不断。在接连数周有前所未有的泄露内容被发布到网上之后，更多有关《GTA6》的信息又流传到了互联网上，这次揭晓了官方原声带专辑收录的全部歌曲和艺人名单。

paragraphs.en: As 13 years turns into just a few days, more leaks felt inevitable. The latest breach arrived in the form of a video shared on social media from what appears to be a Barnes & Noble-like retailer. The main clip being passed around is still up hours later and shows the front, back, and spines of the Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album's double LP vinyl. As you might have guessed, the $50 soundtrack isn't planned to hit store shelves until November 19, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 随着13年的等待变成仅剩几天，更多泄露似乎不可避免。最新泄露是一段在社交媒体上分享的视频，拍摄地点似乎是一家类似Barnes & Noble的零售店。被广泛传播的主要视频片段在数小时后仍未下架，展示了《侠盗猎车手VI：The Album》双LP黑胶唱片的正面、背面和唱片脊。正如你可能猜到的那样，这张售价50美元的原声带原计划要到2026年11月19日才会上架。

paragraphs.en: An early glimpse at the GTA 6 soundtrack means we now know every song and artist featured on the album. Rolling Stone has confirmed the track list with its sources. We won't beat around the bush; you can see the full Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album track list below.
paragraphs.cn: 提前一窥《GTA6》原声带，意味着我们现在知道了专辑收录的每首歌曲和每位艺人。Rolling Stone已向其消息来源确认了这份曲目列表。我们就不拐弯抹角了；你可以在下方查看《侠盗猎车手VI：The Album》的完整曲目列表。

paragraphs.en: We've gotten tastes of the music Rockstar hand-selected to be featured through the years, with stars like Travis Scott, Future, and Morgan Wallen teasing their inclusion as recently as September . We also got to hear some of GTA 6's tunes with the premiere of the Extended Look back in August. As many guessed, the developers have given players a solid playlist of songs from a variety of genres to jam to as they speed through Vice City.
paragraphs.cn: 多年来，我们已陆续听到一些Rockstar亲自挑选收录的音乐；就在今年9月，Travis Scott、Future和Morgan Wallen等明星还曾暗示自己的作品将被收录。我们也在8月《Extended Look》首播时听到了《GTA6》中的一些曲目。正如许多人猜测的那样，开发者为玩家准备了一份扎实的歌单，涵盖多种音乐流派，让玩家在飞驰穿过Vice City时尽情聆听。

paragraphs.en: Fans will note this is different from the Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Grammy Award-winning French electronic duo Justice. It's also set to get its own release for physical music collectors, with its release date set for December 11, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝们会注意到，这与格莱美奖获奖法国电子音乐双人组合Justice创作的《侠盗猎车手VI：Original Score》不同。后者也将面向实体音乐收藏者单独发行，发行日期定于2026年12月11日。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6, of course, will launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X | S November 19, 2026. Today, we also learned that Rockstar has promised next week's new game will include mechanisms to encourage empathy for the first time in the franchise's history . Yesterday, Rockstar revealed a closer look at an animated TV series called Macca & Friends that can be watched in-game.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，《GTA6》将于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series X | S。今天，我们还了解到，Rockstar承诺，下周推出的新游戏将首次在系列历史上加入鼓励共情的机制。昨天，Rockstar更详细地展示了一部名为《Macca & Friends》的动画电视剧，玩家可以在游戏中观看。

paragraphs.en: For more, you can check out IGN's collection of GTA 6's songs and radio stations . You can also check out how some recent gameplay clips are blowing players (and IGN ) away.
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多，你可以查看IGN整理的《GTA6》歌曲和电台。你也可以看看近期一些实机游玩片段是如何令玩家（以及IGN）惊叹的。
